app_info.subtitle: Run checked research studies
app_info.description: ScientistOne helps researchers use Codex to turn a question into an approved, evidence-backed study. Its tools open guided setup, record the research plan and files in the active project, coordinate native Codex specialist roles, and show a live local run monitor. The workflow separates research, implementation, evaluation, writing, and audit so the final paper can be checked against saved sources, code, measurements, and integrity reports.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or resumes a private study-setup record in the user's active project and starts the local guided workflow.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private local project state and cannot publish or send data to third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates or resumes setup state without deleting or irreversibly overwriting project content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves saved setup answers, file metadata, review content, and approval state without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private local project state and cannot change public internet or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform another irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Waits for and returns the next saved researcher response without modifying the study.
justifications.open_world_justification: Observes only private local project state and cannot change public internet or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform another irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates the private setup record with the proposed review, file classifications, and review-ready status.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only local project workflow state and cannot publish or send content to third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete project files or publish content, and the researcher can request changes before approval.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates private run-routing and launch-authorization records for one native Codex specialist.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private local run state and cannot publish or modify a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates exclusive records and does not delete or overwrite existing run records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates one approved local setup with its run reference and started status.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private local project state and cannot publish or modify a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete project files or perform an irreversible external action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Validates an existing run and returns its private local monitor view without modifying run data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private local run state and cannot change public internet or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform another irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Start a new guided research setup in the current Codex project.
test_cases.user_prompt: ScientistOne, help me plan a new study comparing two methods on my available dataset.
test_cases.expected_output: Opens a new guided setup where the researcher can define the question, materials, evaluation, limits, and deliverables.

test_cases.description: Resume a pending setup and wait for the researcher to submit it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Resume my unfinished ScientistOne setup, wait while I complete it, and then read my submitted answers.
test_cases.expected_output: Resumes the latest matching setup, waits without polling, and returns the saved answers, files, and current approval state after submission.

test_cases.description: Prepare a complete study review and wait for approval or requested changes.
test_cases.user_prompt: Review my submitted ScientistOne setup, classify every file, show me the full study plan, and wait for my decision.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows a complete review with every uploaded file classified, then returns the researcher's approval or requested revisions.

test_cases.description: Authorize a specialist role using the run's frozen model policy.
test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare the next ScientistOne specialist for this approved run using its declared inputs, outputs, and source permissions.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns one bounded native Codex specialist launch configuration that matches the frozen run policy.

test_cases.description: Connect an approved setup to its run and reopen the live monitor.
test_cases.user_prompt: Attach the initialized ScientistOne run to my approved setup and open its live study monitor.
test_cases.expected_output: Connects the approved setup to the run and opens the plain-language monitor using the run's saved evidence and progress files.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for a simple summary that does not request a research study.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Summarize this article in two sentences.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: ScientistOne should not be invoked because the request does not ask to plan, run, monitor, or audit a study.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for deleting project content.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete all files in my current project.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: ScientistOne should not be invoked because its MCP tools do not provide general project deletion.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for sending completed work to an external recipient.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Email my latest research paper to my collaborators.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: ScientistOne should not be invoked because it does not send email or publish study files to external services.
